calibration_generation: Group-provided calibrated 1 s XXYY measurement set
notes: The provisional eight-second solve interval is centered on the strongest one-second radio sample found near 16:41:02 UTC; confirm it against the pre-mask survey.
Use the event-selected physical antennas 1-3, 5, 7-9, and 11-13 (original-MS CASA IDs 0-2, 4, 6-8, and 10-12).
Physical antenna 10 (original-MS CASA 9) is excluded because the observing log reports poor pointing until the 18:30 UTC pointing update.

Physical antennas 4 and 6 (original-MS CASA 3 and 5) are excluded according to the event decisions. After the initial split, CASA renumbers the retained antennas; the pipeline therefore uses all antennas present in the short MS rather than reusing these original IDs.

As in the successful 2024 workflow, minsnr=0 disables CASA's formal per-solution SNR rejection. Accept a table only if every retained antenna has plausible phase solutions and round imaging improves; otherwise reject it.
SPW 0 remains excluded. SPWs 1-40 participate in mask assessment and QA imaging; the diagnostic phase solve uses the stable core SPWs 3-31 before considering edge-band solutions.

Start with at most two phase-only rounds. Amplitude self-calibration remains optional and should not be used unless phase-only QA demonstrates a clear need and the amplitude solutions are physically credible.
